Elevate Your WooCommerce Store to Enterprise Level

RevCent: The Ultimate AI-Powered Ecommerce Platform

RevCent is the most comprehensive AI-powered ecommerce platform designed for ambitious businesses ready to scale. With enterprise-grade features, advanced automation, intelligent analytics, and cutting-edge artificial intelligence, RevCent transforms how you manage and grow your online business.

🤖 AI-First Approach:
RevCent offers a full suite of AI tools that make ecommerce businesses more efficient, profitable, and customer-focused. From AI chat assistants to autonomous voice agents, RevCent puts artificial intelligence at the core of your business operations.

🚀 Key Platform Features:
• AI-Powered Automation – Fully autonomous AI assistants that run custom workflows in the background
• Advanced Payment Processing – Multiple gateway support with intelligent routing and fraud detection
• AI Voice Agents – Inbound and outbound AI-powered phone support with native voice technology
• Customer Management – Complete CRM with AI-enhanced analytics and behavioral tracking
• Order Management – Comprehensive order processing with AI-driven fulfillment optimization
• Revenue Recovery – AI-automated systems to recover failed transactions and reduce churn
• AI Reporting & Analytics – Natural language business intelligence with interactive visualizations
• Subscription Management – Enhanced recurring billing and subscription lifecycle management

� Revolutionary AI Capabilities:

AI Chat & Commands

  • Chat with AI throughout the entire platform about any data or customer
  • Issue natural language commands to perform complex operations instantly
  • AI can refund products, send emails, process payments, and manage orders
  • Pre-built and custom prompts for common business operations
  • Available wherever you’re viewing customer, order, or product details

AI Assistants – Fully Autonomous

  • Create custom AI workflows that run in the background
  • Trigger on events, schedules, API calls, or manual execution
  • AI can analyze data, make decisions, and take actions without human intervention
  • Example: Auto-retry declined payments, send complaint follow-ups, generate reports
  • Simple or complex workflows with unlimited customization

AI Voice Agents – Revolutionary Customer Service

Transform Your WooCommerce Customer Service with AI Voice Technology

RevCent’s AI Voice Agents provide 24/7 phone support that sounds completely natural and can handle complex customer service tasks. Perfect for WooCommerce stores that want to scale customer service without hiring more staff.

🔄 Inbound Customer Service
* Automatic Call Answering: AI instantly answers calls to your business phone numbers
* Customer Recognition: Automatically matches phone numbers to WooCommerce customer accounts
* Order Support: Can look up WooCommerce orders, check shipping status, and provide tracking info
* Payment Processing: Securely collect new payment information and retry failed orders
* Refund Handling: Process refunds in WooCommerce with appropriate reasoning
* Product Questions: Answer questions about products, shipping policies, and store information
* Issue Resolution: Handle complaints, returns, and exchange requests professionally

📞 Outbound Customer Recovery
* Abandoned Cart Recovery: Call customers who left items in their WooCommerce cart
* Failed Payment Follow-up: Automatically call when WooCommerce orders fail payment processing
* Order Issue Alerts: Proactively call about shipping delays or product availability
* Customer Satisfaction: Follow up after delivery to ensure customer happiness
* Subscription Renewals: Contact customers before subscription renewals or when cards expire
* Win-back Campaigns: Call dormant customers with personalized offers to return

🎯 WooCommerce-Specific Capabilities
* Order Lookup: “Hi, I’m calling about order #12345 that was placed yesterday…”
* Payment Updates: “I can help you update your payment method for that pending order”
* Shipping Questions: “Your order shipped via FedEx and should arrive Thursday”
* Return Processing: “I’ll process that return and send you a prepaid shipping label”
* Product Recommendations: Suggest related products based on purchase history
* Store Policies: Explain shipping, return, and warranty policies clearly

AI Reporting – Natural Language Analytics

  • Ask complex business questions in plain English
  • AI generates interactive charts, tables, and visualizations
  • Access all your RevCent data through conversational interface
  • Create custom reports with multiple charts in a single request
  • Export and save reports for recurring analysis

Enterprise AI Integration

  • Compatible with OpenAI, Google AI, xAI, and OpenRouter models
  • Use the latest AI models as they become available
  • 100+ system tools available to AI for comprehensive automation
  • Custom JavaScript functions to extend AI capabilities
  • Full API access for AI assistants and voice agents

�🚀 Why Choose RevCent?

RevCent isn’t just another CRM. It’s a complete ecommerce ecosystem that transforms how you run your online business:

  • AI-Powered Automation – Let artificial intelligence handle customer support, revenue recovery, and business optimization
  • Enterprise Payment Tools – Advanced payment routing, anti-fraud protection, and decline recovery
  • Complete Business Management – Centralize all your ecommerce operations in one powerful platform
  • Maximum Conversion Tracking – First-party DNS tracking

🎯 Key Features:

Advanced Payment Processing

  • Smart Payment Routing – Automatically route payments to the gateway with highest success probability
  • Revenue Recovery – Recover lost sales from abandoned carts and soft declines
  • Anti-Fraud Protection – Sentinel fraud prevention protects your merchant accounts
  • Multiple Gateway Support – Balance volume across unlimited payment processors

AI Voice Agents for WooCommerce

  • 24/7 Customer Service – AI answers calls and handles customer inquiries around the clock
  • WooCommerce Integration – Direct access to orders, customers, products, and payment methods
  • Inbound Support – Handle order questions, shipping inquiries, and payment issues
  • Outbound Recovery – Call customers for cart abandonment and failed payment recovery
  • Natural Conversations – Native voice technology that sounds completely human
  • Call Intelligence – Automatically match callers to customer records and order history

Additional AI Integration

  • AI Chat – Get instant answers and automate tasks throughout your business
  • AI Assistants – Run fully automated workflows in the background
  • AI Reporting – Generate insights and charts through natural language

Comprehensive Tracking

  • DNS Tracking – First-party cookie tracking across all your domains
  • Cross-Domain Tracking – Track customers across multiple websites seamlessly
  • Conversion Attribution – Know exactly which ads and campaigns drive sales
  • Metadata Collection – Capture and utilize detailed visitor and customer data

  • Centralized Dashboard – Manage all your stores from one location
  • Customer Segmentation – Group customers by behavior, value, and characteristics
  • Automated Fulfillment – Handle shipping and notifications automatically
  • Advanced Reporting – Real-time analytics with customizable dashboards

Modern Checkout Experience

  • Mobile Optimized – Responsive design that works perfectly on all devices

  • Secure Processing – PCI-compliant payment handling and card storage
  • Developer Friendly – Comprehensive hooks and filters for customization

  • Data-Driven Marketers – Detailed attribution and conversion tracking
  • Automation Enthusiasts – AI-powered business automation

– Send automated order confirmations and shipping notifications
– Create personalized email campaigns based on purchase behavior
– Handle returns and refunds with automated workflows
– AI voice agents for 24/7 customer support

– Generate custom reports with AI assistance through natural language

sections.installation:
Quick Setup:

  1. Install the Plugin

    • Install from the WordPress plugins directory
    • Activate the plugin

  2. Create Your RevCent Account

    • Visit RevCent to set up a demo
    • No setup fees or long-term contracts required

  3. Configure the Gateway

    • Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments > RevCent Payments
    • Enter your API credentials from your RevCent account
    • Enable the payment gateway

  4. Advanced Setup (Optional)

    • Enable DNS tracking for cross-domain visitor tracking
    • Configure payment routing and anti-fraud settings in RevCent
    • Set up automated email templates and customer segmentation

🎙️ AI Voice Agent Setup for WooCommerce:

  1. Phone Number Integration

    • Connect your existing business phone number or get a new one through Twilio
    • Configure inbound routing to RevCent AI Voice Agents
    • Set up outbound calling from your business number

  2. WooCommerce Data Access

    • AI automatically syncs with your WooCommerce customer and order data
    • Configure customer matching by phone number and email
    • Set up real-time order status and inventory access

  3. Voice Agent Instructions

    • Customize AI personality to match your brand voice
    • Configure store-specific policies (returns, shipping, etc.)
    • Set up escalation rules for complex issues

  4. Automation Triggers

    • Inbound: Route calls based on customer type or issue
    • Outbound: Auto-trigger calls for failed payments, cart abandonment
    • Proactive: Schedule follow-up calls for VIP customers

  5. Quality Assurance

    • Review call transcripts and recordings
    • Monitor AI performance and customer satisfaction
    • Continuously optimize based on real customer interactions
sections.faq:
What makes RevCent different from other payment processors?

RevCent is a complete ecommerce management platform, not just a payment processor. You get AI automation, advanced analytics, revenue recovery, anti-fraud protection, and business management tools all in one platform.

Can I manage multiple WooCommerce stores?

Absolutely. RevCent is designed for multi-store operations. You can centralize management, reporting, and customer data across all your WooCommerce stores in one dashboard.

What about subscription products?

RevCent excels at subscription management with advanced renewal recovery, automated billing, and customer lifecycle management.

Is there a monthly fee?

RevCent uses success-based pricing: 1% of successfully processed revenue. No setup fees, per-transaction fees, or long-term contracts.

How does the AI automation work?

RevCent’s AI is revolutionary in ecommerce. It can:
– Chat everywhere: Ask questions and give commands throughout the platform
– Handle phone calls: AI voice agents answer customer calls and make outbound calls
– Run autonomously: AI assistants work 24/7 in the background following your custom workflows
– Generate insights: Ask complex questions in plain English and get interactive reports
– Take actions: Process payments, send emails, manage orders, and more automatically
– Learn and adapt: Uses latest AI models from OpenAI, Google, xAI, and others

The AI has access to 100+ system tools and can be customized with your own JavaScript functions.

What about fraud protection?

RevCent includes Sentinel, an advanced anti-fraud system that prevents fraudulent transactions from reaching your merchant accounts, protecting your payment processing relationships.

Can I track conversions across multiple domains?

Yes! RevCent’s DNS tracking sets first-party cookies across all your domains, providing accurate conversion tracking.

What AI models does RevCent support?

RevCent integrates with all major AI providers including OpenAI, Google AI (Gemini), xAI (Grok), and OpenRouter. You can easily switch between providers and models to use the latest AI technology as it becomes available.

How do AI Voice Agents work with my WooCommerce store?

RevCent’s AI Voice Agents are game-changing for WooCommerce customer service:

Inbound Call Handling:
– Customer calls your store number → AI answers professionally
– AI automatically looks up caller in your WooCommerce customer database
– Can access full order history, shipping info, and payment details
– Handles 80%+ of common questions without human intervention
– Seamlessly transfers complex issues to human staff when needed

Outbound Call Automation:
– Triggers automatically when WooCommerce orders fail or are abandoned
– AI calls customers with personalized information about their specific order
– Can collect new payment information and retry failed transactions
– Follows up on shipping issues, delivery confirmations, and satisfaction

WooCommerce Integration:
– Direct API connection to your WooCommerce store data
– Can process refunds, update orders, and modify customer information
– Accesses product catalog to answer detailed product questions
– Updates order notes and customer records automatically
– Works with your existing WooCommerce workflows and processes

Real Conversations:
– Uses advanced voice synthesis that sounds completely natural
– Handles interruptions, clarifications, and complex conversations
– Adapts tone and language to match your brand voice
– Provides complete call transcripts for quality assurance
– Available 24/7 in multiple languages and time zones

Can AI Voice Agents increase my WooCommerce sales?

Yes! AI Voice Agents are proven revenue drivers:
– Cart Recovery: Recover 15-25% of abandoned carts through personalized calls
– Payment Recovery: Retry failed payments with 40-60% success rates
– Customer Retention: Proactive service calls increase lifetime value by 20-30%
– 24/7 Availability: Never miss a customer inquiry, even outside business hours
– Instant Response: No hold times or delays mean happier customers
– Consistent Service: Every customer gets the same high-quality experience
